Overview

This general purpose copper pipe is suitable for above ground services. It is lightweight, easily hand manipulated and able to withstand high internal pressure, making it ideal for hot and cold water systems, central heating and gas services installations.

## Benefits

*   Suitable for hand manipulation and forming
*   Maximum working pressure up to 58 bar up to 65C
